title: Full Stack Developer
description: About ProjectPulse ProjectPulse is a technology company developing AI-powered solutions for the construction industry. Our platform connects design, estimation and project management to help construction professionals make smarter, faster and more informed decisions. Experience: 3–6 years of relevant practical experience; strong evidence of capability will also be considered. Build the web applications and services that connect design/BIM data with quantities, cost and project decisions. You will own features from understanding the user’s workflow through implementation, testing, release and production follow-through. What you will do Build usable interfaces for BOQ review, cost mapping, estimation, project data and emerging planning workflows. Develop APIs, data models and background processing for large BIM-derived datasets, imports, exports and integrations. Connect tabular information with 3D selection and highlighting, working with BIM engineers on consistent element references. Implement project permissions, validation, audit history and secure access in collaboration with InfoSec. Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD) and ensure high code quality through comprehensive unit and integration testing. Improve query efficiency, responsiveness and failure recovery; investigate production defects and close them with QA. Review code, document technical decisions and turn customer-specific requests into maintainable product capabilities. What you bring Experience delivering production web applications across frontend, backend and database layers. Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern frontend framework, plus proficiency in a backend language frameworks Extensive hands-on experience using Git for version control, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and conflict resolution. Practical experience with relational data modeling, SQL, REST APIs, asynchronous processing and automated tests. An engineer who enjoys moving fast without compromising engineering quality Understanding of authentication, authorization, secure coding and collaborative code review. Ability to debug across the stack and explain technical choices in terms of usability, accuracy and maintainability. Useful additional experience Azure, Auth0, Three.js or other browser-based 3D tools; large data grids; SaaS permissions; construction, estimating or engineering software. How you will work in our startup Turn an unclear user need into a small, testable feature; discuss trade-offs early and adapt as feedback comes in. Be comfortable with evolving requirements, take initiative, seek feedback and help across disciplines while keeping commitments visible. Share an example of working through ambiguity, responding to feedback or helping a small team deliver with limited resources. Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month Ability to commute/relocate: Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred) Experience: Full-stack development: 3 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person
